page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance. The lack of local storage and the 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio represent clear architectural tradeoffs, prioritizing raw compute capacity over memory-intensive or storage-heavy operations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed of 3.4 GHz make this instance suitable for compute-bound workloads that do not require large memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, microservices, and lightweight CI/CD pipelines where CPU performance is the primary constraint.
